summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Client Kanban replacing the right side of the dual-view section on the landing page. Confirmed all 11 acceptance criteria: project header (Lumière Brand Website, ON TRACK pill, DUE MAY 20 pill, JR/AL/KP avatar stack, 68% progress with width 68%), 3 columns with correct counts (To Do=2, In Progress=3, Done=4), exact card titles and due/completion dates in each column, gold left border (2px #c9a84c) on IN PROGRESS cards, hover translateY(-2px) on TO-DO and IN-PROGRESS cards, bottom status bar with 2 BLOCKERS / 3 IN PROGRESS / 4 COMPLETED and 'Last updated — 2 hours ago', subtask progress 0/3 visible, and that the left provider panel is unchanged (OUT OF SCOPE flags, SCOPE CREEP DETECTED — $1,800 UNBILLED) and the trailing headlines 'They see progress.' / 'You see the truth.' still render. Backend smoke /api/health returns 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx is 1665 lines — recommend splitting into per-section components (Hero/TwoViews/ClientKanban/Pricing/etc.) under src/pages/landing/ for maintainability. Not blocking.
ClientKanban data (todoCards/ipCards/doneCards) is hard-coded inside the component — fine for marketing but consider lifting to a constants file if it's reused elsewhere.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kanban is rendered inside [data-testid='client-kanban'] within [data-testid='two-views-section']. To reach final visual state without scroll-driven IntersectionObserver, evaluate document.querySelectorAll('.r, .r-scale, .r-left, .split, .story-bar').forEach(e => e.classList.add('in', 'go')) and scroll to the section. Column structure: .grid.grid-cols-3 > 3 column divs; each column has cards with [data-hover]. IP cards have inline borderLeft 2px #c9a84c. Done cards render at opacity 0.7. Verified visually in screenshot — design matches spec. Backend /api/health smoke = 200. Note: requesting /api/health with default urllib User-Agent returns 403 (Cloudflare-style bot filter); use curl with browser UA or requests with default UA for backend checks from outside.
